title: The pronunciation lexicon
description: content/voice/lexicon.json (docs/voice-narration-plan.md section 2): how made-up words are said. A respelling replaces the whole word in what is sent to the voice model, never on screen. `npm run voice:lexicon` lists the names the game says aloud that have no entry yet.

say.description: The respelling sent to the voice model, e.g. "Pibb".

reviewed.description: false until a person has heard it; absent reads as reviewed.
